b1-nacionalismo-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New States
b1-nacionalismo-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have watched a documentary about Latin America in the early twentieth century, and Carlos asks what changed in the governments.
b1-nacionalismo-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what was created in those years.
cues: Say that new ministries were created
Say that central banks were created in the 1920s
b1-nacionalismo-01.target: Se crearon nuevos ministerios. En la década de 1920 se crearon bancos centrales.
b1-nacionalismo-01.english: New ministries were created. In the 1920s central banks were created.
b1-nacionalismo-01.canDo: I can say what was created or introduced, with *se* + a verb.

b1-nacionalismo-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Mexican Muralists
b1-nacionalismo-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are at a museum exhibition about Mexican murals, and Meg asks about the painters.
b1-nacionalismo-02.prompt: Tell Meg about the three painters.
cues: Say that the three painters had different styles
Say that all of them painted the history of the country
b1-nacionalismo-02.target: A pesar de que los tres pintores tenían estilos distintos, todos pintaron la historia del país.
b1-nacionalismo-02.english: Although the three painters had different styles, all of them painted the history of the country.
b1-nacionalismo-02.canDo: I can admit a contrast and go on, with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* or *pese a*.

b1-nacionalismo-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Schools in the Countryside
b1-nacionalismo-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are reading about the rural schools of Mexico after 1921, and Carlos asks about the teachers.
b1-nacionalismo-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened as rural schools opened.
cues: Say that as rural schools opened, more teachers were needed
Say that the more the school spread, the more visible the State was
b1-nacionalismo-03.target: A medida que se abrían escuelas rurales, se necesitaban más maestros. Cuanto más se extendía la escuela, más visible era el Estado.
b1-nacionalismo-03.english: As rural schools opened, more teachers were needed. The more the school spread, the more visible the State was.
b1-nacionalismo-03.canDo: I can link two changes that grow together, with *a medida que* or *cuanto más ..., más ...*.

b1-nacionalismo-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Life in Isolated Regions
b1-nacionalismo-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you about life in the mountains before the railways, after a class on Latin American history.
b1-nacionalismo-04.prompt: Tell Meg how people lived and travelled.
cues: Say that in the mountains people lived almost without contact with the government
Say that with the railway people travelled faster
b1-nacionalismo-04.target: En las montañas se vivía casi sin contacto con el gobierno. Con el ferrocarril se viajaba más rápido.
b1-nacionalismo-04.english: In the mountains people lived almost without contact with the government. With the railway people travelled faster.
b1-nacionalismo-04.canDo: I can say what people in general did, with *se* + a singular verb.

b1-nacionalismo-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How the State Changed
b1-nacionalismo-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have been reading about the early twentieth century, and Carlos asks how the State changed.
b1-nacionalismo-05.prompt: Tell Carlos how the State changed.
cues: Say that the State became a very important actor
Say that the bureaucracy became bigger
b1-nacionalismo-05.target: El Estado se convirtió en un actor muy importante. La burocracia se hizo más grande.
b1-nacionalismo-05.english: The State became a very important actor. The bureaucracy became bigger.
b1-nacionalismo-05.canDo: I can say how something changed, with *convertirse en*, *hacerse*, *volverse* and *quedarse*.

b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Nationalism and the State
b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. After a class on nationalism and the State, Meg asks you what the new states created.
b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what changed in the states.
cues: Say that ministries and central banks were created
Say that the State became a more important actor
b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.target: Se crearon ministerios y bancos centrales. El Estado se convirtió en un actor más importante.
b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.english: Ministries and central banks were created. The State became a more important actor.
b1-nacionalismo-consolidation.canDo: I can say what the new states created, with the passive with *se*.
